objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Use the SQL injection in NodeBazaar's catalog search to read the flag stored in the flags table of the shop's database.
hints: Upstream's lab guide 03 (SQL injection) points at the catalog search.
The search results are rows of a SELECT: combine them with rows from another table once you know how many columns the products query returns.

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which query string parameter of /search is concatenated into the SQL statement?

steps.title: Identify the database
steps.prompt: Which database server runs the product queries? (name only)

steps.title: Pick the technique
steps.prompt: Which SQL operator appends the rows of another table to the search results?

steps.title: Enumerate the tables
steps.prompt: Which standard schema lists the tables of the database, including flags?
